data.text: [00:04]Hi, Lucy … you’re back! `[00:07.3]I wasn’t sure when your flight was.
[00:09]Yes … well, I’ve just got back actually. `[00:13.3]I arrived last night, so I’m really tired. `[00:17.2]You know, I haven’t got used to the time difference yet.
[00:20.5]Did you have a good time?

[00:21.8]Yes! It was great. `[00:23.9]I mean, there were some difficult moments … but mostly it was really good. `[00:30.5]When I was in Rio, I met an old school friend of mine – Andy. `[00:36.5]I didn’t know he was there, but we bumped into each other in an internet café.

[00:42.5]Mmm … well, we travelled together for a bit, but actually he was really annoying, so in the end, I told him I wanted to travel on my own. `[00:53.3]It was a bit difficult, but after that I had a fantastic time.

[00:59]Well, after Rio, I went up the coast to Salvador – it was really lovely. `[01:05.8]Then I went further north to Fortaleza and to lots of amazing beaches near there. `[01:12.9]It’s completely idyllic actually – miles and miles of beautiful beaches.
[01:19.2]Wow! Were you on your own all the time?

[01:22.8]No, actually – there were lots of other people travelling, so most of time I wasn’t on my own at all. `[01:29.8]In fact, I met a really nice woman called Emily – she was Australian. `[01:35.2]We got on really well and travelled together for the rest of my time in Brazil.
[01:43]Have you got any photos yet?
[01:45]Well, yes, I’ve put some up on Facebook already … and I’m going to put some more up today.
